newsitem.title: USA: Western Staff sees medical oper revs up.
newsitem.headline: Western Staff sees medical oper revs up.

text.p: Western Staff Services Inc's goal is to grow its medical operation to $200 million in system revenues over the next two years through internal growth, licensed conversions and acquisitions.

It said it reorganized its Western Medical Services division. The medical arm will now operate as a wholly-owned unit. Western's vice chairman and former chief administrative officer Harvey Maslin will serve as chairman and chief executive officer of Western Medical Services. Mike Nicholson, president of the medical division since 1992, was promoted to president and chief operating officer of the subsidiary.
